articles.headline: Greenberg: Cam Boozer in 'role of Scottie Pippen' with Caleb Foster out
articles.description: Seth Greenberg joins "Get Up" to discuss how significant Caleb Foster's injury is for Duke.

articles.headline: Duke's Caleb Foster out indefinitely with foot fracture
articles.description: Duke starting guard Caleb Foster has a fractured right foot and will be out indefinitely.
